claims.assertion: Yazhi calls Earth a soul game with self-chosen challenges; people choose whether to fight and should care for themselves and loved ones.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says starseeds accept challenges and offer alternatives, but are not responsible for changing others or defeating the Cabal.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says fighting the Cabal feeds it and risks becoming a new Cabal; she favors offering alternatives.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi suspects military operations are psychological, says no source has all truth, and admits lacking facts on individual operations.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
